home.name: 杭州
home.en: a tea company in Hangzhou, and its farm in the hills

chen.name: 陈总
chen.en: the tea company's director: warm, and testing you

zhou.name: 小周
zhou.en: the company's interpreter: bright, fast, and kinder than they look

chennainai.name: 陈奶奶
chennainai.en: 陈总's mother: owns the tea farm, and misses nothing

liudong.name: 刘董
liudong.en: a board member: loud, and talks fast when he thinks you can't follow

sundong.name: 孙董
sundong.en: a board member: quiet, and faster still

gaozong.name: 高总
gaozong.en: 陈总's old business partner: smiling, and wants the farm
